modelCatalog.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview
modelCatalog.description: Google multimodal reasoning model; API identifier gemini-3.1-pro-preview. Low, medium and high thinking settings remain distinct.

modelCatalog.name: Qwen3.8-Max-0902
modelCatalog.description: September 2 snapshot, also identified as qwen3.8-max-2026-09-02. Further post-trained for coding and collaborative work, with native image and video input. Only results established for this snapshot are included.

modelCatalog.name: GLM 5.3 Flash
modelCatalog.description: Scores use compatible results for the displayed reasoning configuration. Includes sourced primary and fallback benchmark measurements.

modelCatalog.name: Qwen3.8 Max (2026-08-03)
modelCatalog.description: Scores use compatible results for the displayed reasoning configuration. Original August 3 API release, distinct from Max 0902 and standalone open weights.

modelCatalog.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
modelCatalog.description: Scores use compatible results for the displayed reasoning configuration. July 31 text-only release; distinct from preview and experimental vision variants.

modelCatalog.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
modelCatalog.description: Scores use compatible results for the displayed reasoning configuration. Includes sourced primary and fallback benchmark measurements.

modelCatalog.name: Qwen 3.8 27B
modelCatalog.description: Dense 27B open-weight reasoning model with native image and video input, tool use, and adjustable reasoning effort. Scores use compatible results for the displayed reasoning configuration.

modelCatalog.name: Claude Fable 5.1
modelCatalog.description: Anthropic frontier model with adaptive reasoning. Fable is the fallback-enabled version of Mythos: provider safeguards route flagged requests to other Claude models. This routing is part of the Fable product, not an optional benchmark enhancement.

modelCatalog.name: Claude Opus 5
modelCatalog.description: Anthropic heavyweight reasoning model with high-effort deliberation across multidisciplinary science, math, and long-context architecture.

modelCatalog.name: GPT-6 Astra
modelCatalog.description: OpenAI flagship multimodal intelligence system with advanced unified planning, scientific hypothesis generation, and autonomous terminal execution.

modelCatalog.name: Grok 4.6
modelCatalog.description: xAI high-compute reasoning model trained on real-time data feeds with strong STEM verification and a 500K token context window.

modelCatalog.name: Muse Spark 1.3
modelCatalog.description: High-throughput reasoning model combining high token generation speed with extended chain-of-thought problem solving.

modelCatalog.name: Kimi K3
modelCatalog.description: Moonshot AI ultra-long context reasoning model specializing in exhaustive codebase analysis and repository-level question answering.

modelCatalog.name: GLM-5.3
modelCatalog.description: Bilingual frontier model featuring enhanced tool execution, autonomous terminal workflows, and scientific mathematics.

modelCatalog.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
modelCatalog.description: Ultra-fast multimodal reasoning model delivering over 320 tokens/sec throughput with native audio/visual grounding and a 1M token context window.

modelCatalog.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
modelCatalog.description: DeepSeek next-gen sparse MoE model with native multi-token prediction, advanced agentic terminal skills, and economical inference costs.

modelCatalog.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
modelCatalog.description: Ultra-economical OpenAI model delivering high reasoning capabilities at under $0.05 per standard task, setting the budget frontier.

modelCatalog.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
modelCatalog.description: OpenAI reasoning model evaluated with tool-augmented workflows across coding and visual reasoning benchmarks.
